findings.summary: Initial orchestration persisted a future_model proposal and visible reasoning-turn audit in separate transactions, so an audit write failure could leave an orphan pending model proposal.
findings.repair: Added createModelProposalWithinTx and made proposal creation, proposal-created event, reasoning-turn audit and provider-reference update one short post-provider transaction.

findings.summary: The first runtime-policy exception checked globally enabled external actions before the reasoning special case, so an accidental main-API caller could have obtained outreach_reasoning permission in active mode.
findings.repair: outreach_reasoning is now evaluated first and is allowed only for serviceName=engagement-api with OUTREACH_V3_REASONING_ENABLED=true, regardless of global external-action mode.

findings.summary: Initial reasoning turn lease was 3 minutes, shorter than the bounded maximum multi-round provider window, allowing a still-live turn to be reclaimed concurrently.
findings.repair: Turn lease increased to 15 minutes, beyond six 90-second provider rounds plus bounded tool execution; stale crashed turns still recover deterministically.

findings.summary: Archiving a conversation during an in-flight provider call could leave the server turn claim uncleared because archived conversation rows were fully immutable.
findings.repair: A follow-up migration allows archived rows only the narrow claim-clearing update while retaining identity/provider/state immutability.

findings.summary: Capiro-managed continuity could feed prior turns back to the model but had no owner-scoped read route for reconstructing visible conversation history after product reload.
findings.repair: Added bounded owner-scoped visible turn history service and GET route; provider-state mode returns null for message bodies Capiro did not retain.

findings.summary: Reasoning needed OpenAI access in engagement-api shadow mode but enabling the global external-action switch would also enable send/OAuth/other unsafe actions.
findings.repair: Added a narrow outreach_reasoning runtime action and reasoning-specific credential resolver method; every unrelated external action remains blocked in shadow mode.

findings.summary: Initial web-isolation architecture verifier scanned .ts but not React .tsx files, where a premature reasoning UI dependency would most likely appear.
findings.repair: Production-source scan now includes .ts and .tsx while excluding tests/specs.

findings.summary: Initial raw-HTTP provider tests used the SDK-only output_text convenience property rather than the raw Responses API output message shape.
findings.repair: Provider tests now parse output[].message.content[].output_text, matching the raw HTTPS API response contract.

prerequisiteBlockers.summary: Phase 3 was owner-authorized to start provisionally while Phase 2 deployed dark acceptance and independent validation close in parallel. Formal Phase 3 acceptance/deployment remains blocked until the exact Phase 2 lineage receives OUTREACH_V3_PHASE2_APPROVED.

notes: No Phase 3 deployment, shared-database migration, UI change, merge, or PR creation has been performed.
No finding was closed by granting direct model state mutation or broadening the external-action switch.
OpenAI provider state is off by default; capiro_managed + store=false is the default retention posture.
No hidden chain-of-thought field exists in Phase 3 persistence or API contracts.
